## Analysis overview

Restricts analysis-ready ADAS-Cog total records to female subjects, summarizes baseline, Week 24, and change from baseline, and performs the treatment comparison model.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADQSADAS`

## Key ADaM variables

- `SEX`: sex, restricted to F
- `PARAMCD`: ACTOT parameter
- `AVAL/BASE/CHG`: analysis, baseline, and change values
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit
- `EFFFL/ANL01FL`: selection flags
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
